chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Attar narrated to me from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf, from Ibn Abi Najran, from Muhammad ibn Abi al-Qasim, from Ali ibn al-Mughira, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

I heard him say: When a person reaches the age of forty, Allah keeps him safe from three diseases: insanity, leprosy, and white spots. When he reaches fifty, Allah lightens his accounting. When he reaches sixty, Allah grants him return (to Him). When he reaches seventy, the people of heaven love him. When he reaches eighty, Allah orders that his good deeds be established and his bad deeds be cast away. When he reaches ninety, Allah forgives what preceded of his sin and what followed, and records him as a prisoner of Allah on His earth.

key_terms.أَهْلُ السَّمَاءِ: The people of heaven (angels or righteous souls)
key_terms.الْبَرَصِ: White spots (a type of skin disease)

ai.seo_question: What are the spiritual rewards for a Muslim at ages forty, fifty, sixty, seventy, eighty, and ninety according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Thawab al-A'mal* outlines a progressive spiritual elevation for the believer, linking physical longevity with divine mercy. It highlights a transition from protection from ailments in one's forties to ultimate forgiveness and the unique status of being 'Allah's prisoner' (*Asir Allah*) on earth by ninety, reflecting the Shia emphasis on the accumulation of good deeds and divine favor in later life.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1.  It is narrated that Imam Ja’far Sadiq (a.s.) said, “When a person reaches the age of forty, Allah keeps him safe from three diseases like insanity, leprosy and white spots. When he  reaches  the  age  of  fifty,  Allah  curtails  his  accounting. When he reaches the age of sixty, Allah makes him return to Himself. When he reaches the age of seventy, the people of heavens  start  loving  him.  When  he  reaches  the  age  of eighty, Allah orders  that  his  good deeds  be  written down and sins not be written. When he reaches the age of ninety, Allah, the Mighty and Sublime forgives his past and present sins and writes him as a prisoner of Allah on His earth.”
